We Effect - Sustainable Watering Systems Inception Phase

description.narrative:
Objectives:
I. To design a technically, economically and politically viable and sustainable programme aimed at reducing poverty, creating employment and trade, by increasing the income and quality of life of the target groups.
II. To connect Sweden and Guatemala by establishing a roadmap for the generation of a business climate and initial public-private ecosystem for the implementation of the Sustainable Watering Systems and Value Chains Program in Guatemala.
III. To identify strategic partners and allies from the public and private sectors in Guatemala and Sweden, as well as other key actors who provide technical and financial resources during the inception stage and during the implementation of the programme.

The inception phase aims to design a programme including sustainable watering systems using renewable energy (such as solar-powered) and smart farming technology , to support small farmers to save water, be more independent and secure more profitable production for their insertion in value chains.
